title: When SCO fired Darl McBride
content:
On October 14, 2009, SCO fired its CEO, Darl McBride. Very nearly 15 years later, McBride died at the age of 64 of complications from ALS. His termination from SCO ended his time as the most hated man in technology.

The post When SCO fired Darl McBride appeared first on The Silicon Underground.
